#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

long long largestEven(long long value) {
    return value - value % 2;
}

long long compute(long long a, long long b) {
    if (a > b) {
        swap(a, b);
    }
    if (a > 3) {
        return largestEven(a * b);
    }
    long long s = b - b % 6;
    int o = (int)(b % 6);
    long long h = 0;
    switch ((int)a) {
        case 1:
            switch (o) {
                case 4: h = 2; break;
                case 5: h = 4; break;
                default: h = 0; break;
            }
            break;
        case 2:
            switch (o) {
                case 3: h = 4; break;
                case 4: h = 8; break;
                case 5: h = 10; break;
                default: h = 0; break;
            }
            break;
        case 3:
            switch (o) {
                case 2: h = 4; break;
                case 3: h = 8; break;
                case 4: h = 12; break;
                case 5: h = 14; break;
                default: h = 0; break;
            }
            break;
        default:
            h = 0;
            break;
    }
    if (a + b > 9 && a > 1) {
        return largestEven(a * b);
    }
    return s * a + h;
}

int main() {
    long long n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    cout << compute(n, m) << endl;
    return 0;
}
